decisions.reason: The reset button, switch, and additional buttons do not change the independently specified PIR connector.
The source concerns panel controls and does not alter LED supply, level shifting, or LED power-control behavior.
The controls are identified in the main-board discussion and do not change the sensor board's role as a sensor connector hub.
The source does not change the separate eight-LED array board or its LED count.
The newly clarified panel controls do not alter the switched 5V rail, its GPIO, loads, or operating policy.
The source does not modify the interboard power connector type, pin count, or pin-order rule.
No interboard signal connector or pinout change is stated for the reset button, switch, or additional buttons.
The source identifies controls but assigns none of them to GPIOs, so the existing GPIO mappings remain unchanged.
The current architecture state already places system connectors on the main board, and the source does not change board roles or exclusions.
Panel controls do not affect I2C cable length, pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, or resistor placement.
The source does not change USB data lines or native USB programming behavior.
The reset button, switch, and additional buttons do not alter battery cutoff, NTC sensing, or thermal protection requirements.
